rationale: M59 (#825) follow-up, measured on grails-core Item.java. The mapped_column edge must claim the line where the column's NAME is written: the string literal when explicit (`@Column(name = "user_name")`), the field's declaration line when implicit (`@Column` alone, target = field name). The pre-fix behaviour — stamping the annotation's own line for an implicit target — is forbidden below. The fixture explicitly imports the Jakarta Column annotation: an unbound bare @Column does not prove JPA identity.

forbidRelationships.note: pre-fix: the @Column annotation line; the name timestamp1 is written nowhere on it
